findings.net: Align Networks Inc.'s pending ENQOR applications are likely to obstruct both VENQORI and VENKORI in South Korea, with the case stronger against VENQORI.
findings.legal_position: Against VENQORI, ENQOR is a close truncation and the mobile-app and SaaS wording directly meets the company's digital goods. Against VENKORI, the Q/K difference weakens similarity, but the owner is still likely to win because the same digital goods meet and the remaining sound pattern is close.
findings.practical_position: The applications are pending and current ENQOR use by Align Networks Inc. was not confirmed, but their recent filing leaves no established non-use defence. - **Use-check source:** perplexity_research — no result

findings.net: YIWU TENGDING UMBRELLA CO., LTD. is likely to lose against either proposed form in Japan on the current software-only goods.
findings.legal_position: VENKURI is highly similar to VENKORI and moderately similar to VENQORI. Its registered batteries, cameras, audio equipment, plugs, surveillance monitors and chargers do not meet downloadable water-quality software or online training, so the owner is likely to lose against both forms.
findings.practical_position: The Japanese examiner may raise VENKURI against an application, especially for VENKORI. The record establishes no present basis to treat the owner as an active enforcer.

findings.net: NXP USA, INC.'s Japanese QORIQ registration for semiconductors and microprocessors does not reach either proposed software name.
findings.legal_position: VENQORI visually contains QORI, while VENKORI replaces the Q with K but keeps some local phonetic proximity. The registered semiconductors, microprocessors and integrated circuits occupy a different field from consumer water-quality software and training.
findings.practical_position: NXP identifies QorIQ T1024 as an active processor for networking and industrial applications, which makes the family worth commercial awareness without creating current software overlap. [Official NXP product page](https://www.nxp.com/products/T1024).

distinctiveness.read: VENQORI and VENKORI are coined and distinctive for consumer water-quality software, with the whole word carrying the source-identifying weight.

per_market.note: VENQORI, VENKORI and the Katakana form have no established descriptive meaning for the instructed goods.
VENQORI, VENKORI and the Hangul form have no established descriptive meaning for the instructed goods.

connotation.read: QORI may be read as the Quechua word for gold, but the search did not establish a VENQORI-specific cultural-appropriation concern.
connotation.spectrum: Possible benign cultural or semantic association rather than a loaded reading.

per_market.note: No established slang, gang or offensive reading surfaced for the Latin or local-script forms searched.

connotation.note: - **Meaning-pull:** qori Quechua gold and cultural appropriation → linguistic sources confirm “gold”; the word is not inherently offensive, while branding context determines sensitivity. https://files.eric.ed.gov/fulltext/ED012031.pdf

third_party_rights.read: The strongest third-party rights are the pending Korean ENQOR applications, whose digital goods meet the proposed app and hosted service.
third_party_rights.basis: Finding 1 combines a close sign with directly overlapping mobile-app and SaaS wording.

objection_likelihood.read: An objection is possible in South Korea because ENQOR is pending across all three core classes, although current owner use and enforcement posture remain unconfirmed.
objection_likelihood.basis: The pending ENQOR filings create the only on-field conflict, while the other rights are goods-distinct.

registrability.read: Both forms appear registrable only with conditions because ENQOR creates a Korean obstacle and material coverage questions remain open.
registrability.basis: Finding 1 and the open mixed-script, owner-identity and specialised water-software coverage areas.

obstacles.note: ENQOR covers downloadable mobile and smartphone software in South Korea.
ENQOR covers SaaS, platforms, hosting and software development in South Korea.
ENQOR covers correspondence courses and educational services in South Korea.

client_enforceability.read: The company can enforce each coined whole, but rights in the QORI or KORI sequence alone appear narrower.
client_enforceability.basis: The marks are coined as wholes, while findings 2 to 6 show earlier rights sharing close internal sequences.

coverage_judgment.reason: The exact mixed-script forms, unresolved Vencora owner identity and specialised water-IoT software field remain unsearched, so unconditional clearance is not supported.
